title: Postkit component
description: Scaffolds a Postkit component: a definition, a headless view and its CSS, and optionally a Chakra view, recipe and specs.

name.description: The component name, such as device or CodeSample.

directory.description: Where the component folder goes, from the workspace root. Ignored with --layout=postkit.

chakra.description: Also write a Chakra view and slot recipe.

spec.description: Also write a spec per view.

directive.description: The Markdown directive. Defaults to postkit-<name>.

description.description: A one-line description for the catalog and editors.

importExtension.description: The extension of relative imports: none (bundlers) or js (nodenext).

layout.description: site: one folder for a site's own component. postkit: a built-in in Postkit's own repo (packages/core, react and chakra).
